keyboard: original US; no custom WPK selected
parallel: none; tests use original app print-to-disk when enabled
boot: FreeDOS 1.4 Floppy Edition, 144m/x86BOOT.img; minimal modified FDAUTO.BAT/FDCONFIG.SYS

reproducibility: Each probe copies the same hashed master disk and boot image. Recorded host-timed input and guest clock progression do not imply instruction/bit-identical rebuilds.

Printer disk is dated 1992-07-17; do not describe this as an untouched March 1992 shipping set.
Standard Printer is 10 cpi text-only, not a graphics/font pagination oracle.
rebuild_note: All 157 non-personal-setup files match the first installation. Personal setup is independently fingerprinted; its unexplained one-byte variation is not normalized.
